meta.project: SIT SMAM1 BWI Integrated Information System

product_overview: An integrated school information system for SMAS Muhammadiyah 1 Banyuwangi that supports role-based access for students, parents, teachers, finance staff, and administrators. Users can log in to manage academic activities, attendance, grades, report cards, billing, and RFID-based school services.
core_goals: Log in to the appropriate role-based portal and access permitted school services
Review and submit student learning materials and homework
Record and monitor student attendance and academic performance
Create, view, and pay school fee invoices
Use RFID terminals for attendance check-ins and instant fee payments

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows users to authenticate through the appropriate portal and access role-based school functions, including viewing their profile after login and ending the session when finished.
user_flows: POST /api/login with JSON payload {'username': 'admin', 'password': '1234'} -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/user -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/logout -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/user -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: User Management CRUD
features.description: Allows administrators to create, read, update, and delete user accounts. Created users must map to valid system roles (superadmin, admin, guru, walikelas, kepala_sekolah, kurikulum, bendahara, siswa, orang_tua).
user_flows: POST /api/login with JSON payload {'username': 'admin', 'password': '1234'} -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/users with JSON payload {'username': 'teststudent1', 'password': 'Password123!', 'name': 'Test Student', 'email': 'teststudent1@example.com', 'role': 'siswa'} -> Receive 201 Created with JSON structure {'message': '...', 'user': {'id': created_id, ...}} -> GET /api/users -> Confirm user exists -> DELETE /api/users/{id} -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/logout

features.name: RFID Attendance Logging
features.description: Allows public terminals to log student attendance by scanning RFID cards. The endpoint resolves the card UID and returns the student info.
user_flows: POST /api/absensi/tap with JSON payload {'uid': 'RF:AB:12:CD:34'} -> Receive 200 OK with JSON structure {'message': '...', 'siswa': {...}, 'status': '...'} -> POST /api/absensi/tap with unregistered UID {'uid': 'RF:00:00:00:00'} -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: School Fees Payment
features.description: Allows students to retrieve outstanding invoices and administrators to process payments.
user_flows: POST /api/login with JSON payload {'username': 'agus', 'password': '1234'} -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/pembayaran/tagihan -> Receive 200 OK with JSON structure {'status': 'success', 'data': [invoices_list]} -> Extract first invoice ID as tagihan_id and nominal_tagihan as jumlah_bayar -> POST /api/logout -> POST /api/login with JSON payload {'username': 'admin', 'password': '1234'} -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/pembayaran/proses with JSON payload {'tagihan_id': tagihan_id, 'jumlah_bayar': jumlah_bayar, 'metode': 'tunai', 'catatan': 'test'} -> Receive 200 OK with status success -> POST /api/pembayaran/proses with negative amount {'tagihan_id': tagihan_id, 'jumlah_bayar': -100, 'metode': 'tunai'} -> Receive 400 or 422 error -> POST /api/logout

features.name: LMS Assignments
features.description: Supports homework submission by students and grading by teachers for LMS tasks.
user_flows: POST /api/login with JSON payload {'username': 'agus', 'password': '1234'} -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/user -> Get student ID -> POST /api/lms/tugas/1/submit with JSON payload {'catatan_siswa': 'Finished'} -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/logout -> POST /api/login with JSON payload {'username': 'rina', 'password': '1234'} -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/lms/tugas/1/grade/{siswa_id} with JSON payload {'nilai': 90, 'feedback_guru': 'Great'} -> Receive 200 OK with JSON structure {'status': 'success', 'data': {'nilai': 90, 'feedback_guru': 'Great'}} -> POST /api/lms/tugas/1/grade/{siswa_id} with invalid grade {'nilai': 150} -> Receive 400 or 422 error -> POST /api/logout

features.name: CBT Exam Engine
features.description: Manages CBT exam sessions, answer saving, and exam completion with anti-cheat controls.
user_flows: POST /api/login with JSON payload {'username': 'agus', 'password': '1234'} -> Receive 200 OK -> GET /api/cbt/ujian/sesi-aktif -> Receive 200 OK with JSON list directly as response root -> Extract first session ID as sesi_ujian_id -> POST /api/cbt/ujian/mulai with JSON payload {'sesi_ujian_id': sesi_ujian_id, 'token': 'LOG123'} -> Receive 200 OK with JSON structure {'hasil_ujian_id': hasil_ujian_id, 'soals': [{'id': soal_id, 'opsi_jawabans': [{'id': option_id, ...}]}]} -> POST /api/cbt/ujian/simpan-jawaban with JSON payload {'hasil_ujian_id': hasil_ujian_id, 'soal_id': soal_id, 'opsi_jawaban_id': option_id} -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/cbt/ujian/selesai with JSON payload {'hasil_ujian_id': hasil_ujian_id} -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/logout
